description: This file contains functions for platform-specific image verification and upgrade procedures for Redboot FIS format in an OpenWRT build environment. It defines functions to check image magic words and perform upgrades by extracting and flashing kernel and root filesystem images.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image file has the correct magic word indicating Frboot FIS format.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem from the image file and flashing to device memory.
